notes.title: Steam achievements 🎉
notes.content: [h3]This update introduces [b]8 Steam Achievements[/b] 🏆 — 6 core ones to track your progress 📈, plus 2 secret achievements 🤫 for those who like to dig a little deeper. Whether you're in it for a casual run 🎮 or chasing full completion 💯, there's now more to unlock and explore.[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525058/b21d678da2be1d18f59ed775653990b809d92e23.png"][/img]Can you unlock them all? 🕵️‍♂️🎮[/h3]
